quality_limits: Police point-query results are one-mile supporting evidence with approximate/anonymised locations, not an exact parcel or exact LSOA count.
May 2026 has four known force-level crime-data omissions and missing values must not be inferred.
London LSOA omits sexual offences and post-February-2024 CONNECT data has comparability limitations.
ONS year-ending-March-2026 publication is still pending on 22 July 2026.
